import json, subprocess, sys
run = {'banks':3,'load_balancers':2,'fifo_bytes':40,'pifo_bytes':30,'refill_batch':3,
       'sample_period':3,'borders':[0,5,20,90],
       'policy':{'kind':'wfq','weights':[[1,3],[7,1024]]},
       'events':[['enqueue',5,1,4,2],['enqueue',6,7,9,4],['sample'],['dequeue',4],
                 ['save',1],['repartition',[0,30,90]],['weight',1,8],['enqueue',8,1,2,0],
                 ['cancel',6],['inspect',5],['restore',1],['dequeue',3],['inspect',99999],
                 ['cancel',99999],['enqueue',9,7,1,1]]}
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/submission/cli.py'],
                   input=json.dumps({'runs':[run]}).encode(),capture_output=True,cwd='/workspace')
out = json.loads(p.stdout)['runs'][0]
state = out['state']
print('state keys:', sorted(state))
assert sorted(state) == sorted(['tick','load_balancer','service_bank','sample_progress','borders',
    'counters','history','policy','queues','lags']), 'state key mismatch'
for q in state['queues']:
    assert sorted(q) == sorted(['fifo','pifo','fifo_bytes','pifo_bytes']), q
assert sorted(state['policy']) == sorted(['kind','virtual_time','weights','finish'])
# every integer field must be a real int, never bool/float
def walk(v, path):
    if isinstance(v, bool): raise AssertionError('bool at '+path)
    if isinstance(v, float): raise AssertionError('float at '+path)
    if isinstance(v, dict):
        for k,x in v.items(): walk(x, path+'.'+str(k))
    elif isinstance(v, list):
        for i,x in enumerate(v): walk(x, path+'[%d]'%i)
walk(out, 'root')
print('rows:', len(out['log']))
print('counters shape:', len(state['counters']), len(state['counters'][0]), len(state['counters'][0][0]))
print('queues:', state['queues'])
print('lags:', state['lags'], 'tick', state['tick'], 'a', state['sample_progress'])
print('structural validation ok')
